prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one premium abstract background for the Bifang coding workspace brand, for editable promotional banners and YouTube thumbnails. Create a refined 16:9 landscape background, ideally 3840 by 2160. Base palette: almost-black navy and deep slate #0F172A. A restrained ember-red #E63946 to flame-orange #FF8A3D flow of light and delicate luminous traces belongs mainly along the far right edge and lower-right corner. The left two thirds must stay dark, calm and uncluttered for large white typography. Subtle precision grid, very fine material grain, generous negative space, sophisticated technical keynote/editorial finish. Controlled energy, practical engineering, quiet confidence. No text, no letters, no logos, no birds, no people, no devices, no invented software interfaces, no badges, no watermark. Avoid purple/cyan neon, fantasy flames, chrome emblems, excessive bloom, decorative clutter and generic cyberpunk imagery. This is a reusable brand background, not a new logo.
note: Optional backdrop embedded in the vector-built brand thumbnail; core logos preserve the existing vector mark.
